task:
Mount a ConfigMap as a file inside a Pod.

In namespace 'moon':

  1. The file /opt/course/15/web-moon.html exists on the exam node with HTML content.
     Create a ConfigMap named 'configmap-web-moon-html' from this file:
     kubectl create configmap configmap-web-moon-html \
       --from-file=index.html=/opt/course/15/web-moon.html \
       -n moon

     (The key in the ConfigMap will be 'index.html' and the value will be the file content)

  2. Create a Deployment named 'web-moon' in namespace 'moon' with:
     - Image: nginx:1.21
     - 2 replicas
     - Mount the ConfigMap as a volume at /usr/share/nginx/html
       so that nginx serves the custom HTML page

Setup: create the namespace and the HTML file:
  kubectl create ns moon
  echo '<html><body>Moon Landing</body></html>' > /opt/course/15/web-moon.html
  mkdir -p /opt/course/15

Verify:
  kubectl get cm configmap-web-moon-html -n moon
  kubectl exec -n moon <pod-name> -- cat /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
  # Should show the HTML content
hints: kubectl create configmap --from-file=<key>=<file-path>  sets a specific key name
Mount ConfigMap as volume: volumes[0].configMap.name: configmap-web-moon-html
Each key in the ConfigMap becomes a file in the mounted directory
detailed_hints: Deployment volume spec: {name: html-vol, configMap: {name: configmap-web-moon-html}}
Verify: kubectl get cm configmap-web-moon-html -n moon -o jsonpath='{.data.index\.html}'

validators.command: kubectl get cm configmap-web-moon-html -n moon -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get cm configmap-web-moon-html -n moon -o jsonpath='{.data.index\.html}'
kubectl get deploy web-moon -n moon -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get deploy web-moon -n moon -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}'

validators.description: Deployment mounts volume at nginx html directory
